transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I don’t know… I guess I just haven’t been myself. Things I used to care about, I don’t really touch anymore. My fishing stuff’s just sitting in the garage, and the woodshop… feels like work now. Even with my kids wanting to play chess, I’m there, but I’m not really into it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I guess… about a year and a half. Maybe closer to a year and seven months. Since my wife’s health issues started changing things at home.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day?
Yeah… I mean, I think so. Most days I feel pretty low. It’s just kind of there.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I have. I just kind of stopped caring about the things I used to look forward to. Fishing stuff’s still sitting in the garage, I don’t really want to be in the woodshop, and even chess with the kids… I’m there, but I’m mostly just going through the motions.
Have you been feeling tired or lacking energy, even when you haven't done much physically?

Yeah. Pretty much. By midmorning I feel like I’ve already put in a full shift… even if I haven’t done much. Walking the project or taking stairs with the crew, it’s like my body’s carrying wet concrete.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much, or blaming yourself for things that aren’t really your fault?

Yeah… I do. More than I like to admit.

I keep thinking I’m letting everybody down—my wife, the kids, the guys at work. If something goes wrong, even small stuff… a missed appointment, a cost overrun, some safety thing… I take it like it’s proof I shouldn’t be the one in charge. Like I’m just… useless.
Have you noticed any big changes in your appetite or weight over the last while?

Yeah… I guess so. I don’t really feel hungry much. Food just kind of tastes like nothing, so I skip breakfast a lot and mostly pick at dinner.

I’ve had to tighten my belt a couple notches… wasn’t trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or feeling restless and unable to sit still?

I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid attention to that.

I mean… I don’t think I’m pacing around or anything. If I’m slower, I guess I wouldn’t be surprised, but I haven’t noticed it like that.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?

I don’t know… not like this, I guess.

I’ve had rough patches before, sure, but I can’t really say if it was the same thing. This feels… heavier. Hard to compare.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more?
I can’t really say. I’ve had times where I was low, I guess, but whether it lasted a couple weeks or was like this… I don’t know. I never really kept track.
Before this current period, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I really don’t know. I’ve had bad stretches before, but I can’t say for sure it was two weeks straight or the same as this.
Before this current period, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I don’t really know. I know I’ve had periods where I wasn’t myself, but I can’t honestly say if it was two weeks straight before this.
Before this current period, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
I’m sorry, I just… I don’t know how to answer it any clearer. I’ve had rough times, but I can’t say for sure it was at least two weeks in a row before this.
Between your previous rough times and this current period, were there at least two months where you felt like yourself again, without these symptoms?
I’m not sure. I mean, there were times I was functioning better, I guess, but I don’t know if it was a full two months of feeling like myself.
Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, were there ever two months or more where you felt completely back to normal, without any of these symptoms?
I can’t really say that. Maybe there were stretches where I was doing better, but “completely back to normal” for two months… I don’t know.
